about.text: Free, self-hostable wine cellar manager with AI integration through MCP.
bottle.delete_confirm: Permanently delete this bottle? Only for data entry errors: for a bottle you drank, use “Take out”.
bottle.out_done: Bottle taken out of the cellar.
bottle.storage_hint: Rack: the first free slots are used; you can move bottles afterwards.
bottle.title: Bottle
cellar.title: My cellar
col.name: Wine
export.intro: The CSV lists the cellar (re-importable); the JSON is a full backup (wines, bottles, storage, history and images), restorable below.
export.title: Export
history.restore_confirm: Put this bottle back in the cellar?
import.file_hint: CSV or XLSX file: the Vitiplace cellar list (Appellation, Nom, Millésime, Robe, Quantité) or any table with at least Name and Type columns.
import.intro: Import your cellar from Vitiplace or a spreadsheet. A preview is shown before anything is saved.
import.mode.skip_existing: Skip wines/vintages already in the cellar
import.mode_hint: “Skip existing” lets you re-run an import without duplicates.
import.replace_confirm: All current wines, bottles and history will be deleted. Continue?
import.report: {wines} wine(s) created, {bottles} bottle(s) added, {skipped} line(s) skipped, {errors} error(s).
import.title: Import
login.intro: Sign in to access the cellar.
login.throttled: Too many attempts, try again in a few minutes.
login.title: Sign in
phase.drink.help: Ready to drink, peak still ahead.
phase.unknown.help: No drinking window: complete the sheet (or ask an AI through MCP).
plan.search: Find a wine in the racks…
plan.swap_confirm: This slot is taken. Swap both bottles?
plan.unplaced_help: Tap a bottle then “Move”, or tap an empty slot to store a bottle there.
restore.confirm: The current cellar will be fully replaced by the backup. Continue?
restore.intro: Restore a Cellarium JSON backup (replaces the whole cellar; accounts are kept).
restore.title: Restore a backup
settings.title: Settings
setup.code_hint: Printed in the server log on first start.
setup.done: Account created. Now configure your storage.
setup.intro: First start: create the cellar owner's account.
setup.title: Welcome to Cellarium
storage.box_help: A box has no slots: bottles are stored loosely.
storage.delete_confirm: Delete “{name}”? Its {n} bottle(s) will become unplaced.
storage.intro: Racks (rows × columns grid) and boxes (no precise position).
storage.name: Name
storage.none: No storage yet. Add your first rack.
storage.overflow_confirm: {n} bottle(s) fall outside the new grid. Make them unplaced?
summary.empty: Your cellar is empty. Add a wine or import your Vitiplace export.
summary.title: Overview
tokens.copy_now: Copy this token now: it will not be shown again.
tokens.guide_hint: The MCP server ships a guide (get_enrichment_guide tool) forbidding the AI to invent: it only fills information confirmed by sources.
tokens.mcp_config: Example configuration for an MCP client (Streamable HTTP):
tokens.mcp_intro: Connect an AI assistant (Hermes, Claude, …) to your cellar with MCP. A “read” token can browse, a “write” token (owners) can also modify.
tokens.name: Token name
tokens.scope_hint: Write access is only possible for owner accounts.
types.intro: Red, white, rosé, sparkling, sweet and cider are built in; you can add more (orange, perry…).
users.intro: Owners manage the cellar; read-only accounts let you share it.
users.role_hint: Owner: can change everything. Read-only: browse only.
wine.ai_comment_on: Comment added by an AI on {date}
wine.ai_filled: Filled by an AI from sources
wine.already_exists: Already in your cellar? Add bottles instead:
wine.delete_confirm: Delete “{name}” and its {n} bottle(s) in the cellar? History is kept.
wine.first_bottles_hint: Set 0 to only create the wine sheet.
wine.image_remove_confirm: Remove the image from this wine?
wine.lot_delete_confirm: Delete this purchase and its {n} bottle(s)? (error fix, no history)
wine.name_hint: Estate and cuvée, e.g. “Merlet (domaine de) - Cuvée X”.
wine.notes_hint: Personal notes. An AI never edits them: it can only append a comment signed “IA”.
wine.window_help: Enter years (all optional): drink from ≤ peak ≤ drink before.
